facts.fact: The UNDP report of 31 July 2021 says the Head of State's 2019 electoral programme put the emphasis on implementing a strategy for developing digital technologies and improving access to public services through an e-government programme; it records a pledge and names no strategy document or act.
facts.system: stratégie de développement des technologies numériques

facts.fact: The UNDP report says that in February 2020 the government announced the formation of a 'Haut conseil du numérique' (HCN), an inter-ministerial committee charged with recommendations and steering of the national digital strategy, including the digital economy; the act creating it is not named.
